Horizons Arabic Level 1

Arabic letters and first words, brought to life through listening, pictures and writing.

Windows 10/11 · 64-bit. The program and instructions currently support Arabic, Turkish, English, French and Spanish. Expansion to the website’s 32 languages and a male voice are planned as free updates; no release date is set.

A family licence covers up to three registered devices. Activation is handled manually through adult purchase support. A Windows reinstall may require support. Progress stays on your device.

All fixes and updates for this level are free for existing buyers. Future levels are separate products.
